job_title: Co-op Quality Assurance Analyst - Fall 2026 (September to December)
required_skills: Understanding of technical systems and concepts
experience_level: Currently enrolled in a college diploma or university degree and eligible for co-op program
education_requirements: Currently enrolled in a College Diploma or University Degree from an accredited institution and eligible to participate in a co-op program
key_responsibilities: Plan and execute test suites across various products and systems within an Agile software development process
Evaluate, plan, design, develop, and deploy test strategies, test plans, and test cases based on requirements for new or enhanced applications
Perform various types of testing including functional, regression, system integration, back-end database validation, mobile/scalability, cross-browser compatibility, and usability testing
Collaborate with developers and product owners to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria
Liaise with software developers to address bugs and deficiencies discovered during testing
Analyze formal test results to discover and resolve defects, bugs, errors, configuration issues, and interoperability flaws
Produce reports and documentation for all test efforts, results, activities, data, logging, and tracking
Cultivate and disseminate knowledge of application testing best practices

company_research.summary: Info-Tech Research Group is a fast-growing IT research and advisory firm with over 1,400 employees, recently recognized on Deloitte’s 2025 Technology Fast 500 and the Globe and Mail’s Top Growing Companies lists. The company maintains a mid-to-large enterprise scale and is currently expanding its global footprint in AI and strategic advisory services. Employee feedback indicates a generally positive culture (3.3–3.6 stars) that values collaboration and "getting things done," though some reviews mention challenges with upper management and compensation. For a QA Analyst co-op, the environment appears fast-paced and lean, offering exposure to a global firm that is actively investing in new product innovation and AI-driven tools.
